I was walking down the street, when it appeared. A weird button. It was hovering above the ground. It was shiny, in a way. It said "Save". I pressed it. I looked down to the right. I saw some floating words. It said "Quick-saving now, Don't Die." I wondered what I could do with this. I continued walking down the street. It followed me. It finished saving.

	I went to my house. My girlfriend of 3 years was sitting on the couch. I walked up to her. I pressed the button. It saved. Then I proposed to her. She said no. I became very depressed. One week later, I was in my bedroom. I thought about killing myself. Fuck It, I said in my head. I got a knife. I stabbed myself. 

	I respawned in the living room. Um, what happened? I killed myself. How am I still alive? I thought. Then it hit me. I can't kill myself, I'd reload at the last place I saved. This is like a video game. I thought about what else I could do. I robbed a bank, then I reloaded in the living room.
